title: CLI/session commands: view progression and apply level-up
description: Wire progression into the CLI play session: a command to view progression (current XP/level, advancement mode, eligibility, recent ledger events) and a command to apply/start a level-up via the guided flow. Mirrors existing playCharacter/playParty command wiring.
acceptance_criteria: Players can view progression and trigger level-up from the play session; commands surface eligibility and block unsupported level-ups clearly; CLI wiring is covered by tests.
close_reason: Added play-session /progression and /levelup commands backed by the guided level-up flow, with CLI coverage for viewing, applying, and unsupported blockers.
